decoy.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 꾸미려고 미리 짜고 다른 사람의 주의를 흐트러뜨리는 사람.

differentiation.definitionKo: 성질이나 종류에 따라 차이가 남. 또는 성질이나 종류에 따라 갈라놓음.

dongchimi.definitionKo: 무를 소금에 절인 후 끓인 소금물을 식혀서 붓고 심심하게 담근 김치.

sprinkle.definitionKo: 액체나 가루 등을 다른 것 위에 고루 흩어지게 뿌리다.
sprinkle.englishDescription: To pour or sprinkle liquid, powder, etc., evenly on something else.

sprinkle.definitionKo: 바람이 없는 날 소리 없이 가늘게 내리는 비.
sprinkle.englishDescription: Fine rain that falls quietly on a day without wind.
An act of spraying liquid, powder, gas, etc.

sprinkle.definitionKo: 어떤 힘을 받아 물방울, 흙, 파편 등이 세차게 솟아올랐다가 사방으로 흩어지다.
sprinkle.englishDescription: For water drops, soil, pieces of something, etc., to be raised high via the force of an action, and be sprinkled all the place.

sprinkle.definitionKo: 적은 분량의 액체를 붓거나 가루 등을 뿌려서 넣다.
sprinkle.englishDescription: To pour a small amount of liquid in something, or to sprinkle powder, etc., on something.

sprinkle.definitionKo: 비나 눈 등이 흩어져 뿌려지다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
sprinkle.englishDescription: For snow, rain, etc., to scatter and fall, or to make this happen.

stash.englishDescription: (figurative) A place where one stashed his/her belongings.

station.definitionKo: 사람이 타고 내릴 수 있게 버스나 기차 등이 멈추는 장소.
station.englishDescription: A place where buses, trains, etc., stop so people can get on and off the vehicle.

station.definitionKo: 군대나 탐험대 등이 머물면서 활동할 수 있게 필요한 시설을 갖춘 장소.
station.englishDescription: A place equipped with facilities required for troops or an expedition team in which they can stay and perform activities.
A place where a train departs and arrives.

status.englishDescription: An individual's role or position within a society.

status.definitionKo: 봉건 사회에서 제도적으로 개인에게 주어진 지위나 서열.
status.englishDescription: A status or rank given institutionally to an individual in a feudal society.

status.definitionKo: 재판이나 소송, 사건 등에서 가지는 지위.
status.englishDescription: One's position in a trial, lawsuit, case, etc.
Someone's rank or position based on his/her social class.

status.definitionKo: 주위 환경이나 사회에 어울리는 수준이나 품위.
status.englishDescription: One's level or dignity matching those of one's environment or society.

status.definitionKo: 다른 사람이나 조직이 인정하는 높은 지위나 등급.
status.englishDescription: A high status or rank recognized by other people or organization.

status.definitionKo: 어떤 사물이 다른 사물과의 관계 속에서 가지는 위치나 상태.
status.englishDescription: A position or state held by a certain object in a relationship with another.
A status or a person of such status.
The way an object looks or a phenomenon unfolds.

stint.englishDescription: The state of being responsible for a certain job or task.

stone.definitionKo: 손에 쥘 수 있을 만한 작은 크기의 돌.
stone.englishDescription: A small stone that can be held in one hand.

stone.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 생명체가 아닌 것처럼 감정이 없거나 몸이 굳은 것.
stone.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which one shows an absence of emotions like an inanimate object, or his/her body becomes stiff.

stone.definitionKo: 바둑에서, 바둑판에 놓은 돌이나 상대에게 따낸 돌을 세는 단위.
stone.englishDescription: In the game of go, a bound noun used to count the number of stones placed on the board or those captured from the opponent.

stone.definitionKo: 흙이나 모래 등이 굳어서 생긴 단단한 덩어리.
stone.englishDescription: A hard mass formed when dirt, sand, etc., is solidified.

stone.definitionKo: 건축이나 토목 공사 등에 쓰는, 돌로 된 재료.
stone.englishDescription: A material made of stone that is used in architectural or civil construction.

stone.definitionKo: 바둑을 둘 때 쓰는 둥글고 납작한 작은 돌.
stone.englishDescription: A small, flat, round stone used for playing go.

strange.definitionKo: 전에 보거나 듣거나 경험한 적이 없어 익숙하지가 않다.
strange.englishDescription: Having not previously seen, heard of, or experienced something, and thus being not familiar with it.

strange.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 감정 등이 표현하기 어려울 만큼 기이하다.
strange.englishDescription: A happening, sentiment, etc., being too odd to be expressed.

strange.definitionKo: 어떤 대상이 익숙하지 못하고 낯이 설다.
strange.englishDescription: Not accustomed to or familiar with something.

strange.definitionKo: 원래 알고 있던 것과 달리 별나거나 색다르다.
strange.englishDescription: Something being uncommon or odd because it is different from what one knows about it.
Odd, eccentric, weird, and not normal.
Completely different from what is considered common sense.

stump.definitionKo: 나무나 풀 등의 줄기의 아랫부분. 또는 나무나 풀 등의 줄기를 베고 남은 아랫부분.
stump.englishDescription: The lower part of grass or a tree, or the remaining part after grass or a tree is cut down.

stump.definitionKo: 나무나 풀 등의 줄기의 아래 부분. 또는 나무나 풀 등의 줄기를 베고 남은 아래 부분.
stump.englishDescription: The lower part of grass or a tree, or the remaining part after grass or a tree is cut down.

stump.definitionKo: 줄기를 잘라 낸 나무의 맨 아래 굵은 부분.
stump.englishDescription: The lower thick part of a tree, of which the trunk is cut off.

summon.englishDescription: To ask for someone to come.

summon.definitionKo: 국가의 사무를 집행하는 기관에서 명령해서 오게 하다.
summon.englishDescription: For a state agency to order someone to come.

summon.definitionKo: 법원이나 검찰 등이 피고인, 참고인, 증인 등의 소송 관계인에게 일정한 일시에 지정한 장소로 올 것을 명령하다.
summon.englishDescription: For the court, prosecution, etc., to order a person related to a case such as a defendant, reference, witness, etc.,  to come to a certain place, at a certain time, on a certain date.

summon.definitionKo: 조사 등을 받게 하기 위해 경찰서나 법원 등에 직접 나가게 하다.
summon.englishDescription: To make someone be present at a police station, court of law, etc., in person, for an interview or investigation.

summon.definitionKo: 전화나 전신 등을 통해 상대방을 부르다.
summon.englishDescription: To call someone to come by phone or telegraph.

sunken.definitionKo: 가운데가 둥글게 푹 파이거나 들어간 데가 있다.
sunken.englishDescription: Being dented or curved inwards in the middle.

sunken.definitionKo: 가운데가 둥글게 푹 패어 있거나 들어가 있는 상태이다.
sunken.englishDescription: Hollowed out or curving inwards in the middle.

sunken.definitionKo: 가운데가 둥글게 푹 파이거나 들어간 데가 있다.
sunken.englishDescription: Hollowed out or curving inwards in the middle.

sunken.definitionKo: 눈이 움푹 패어 기운 없어 보이다.
sunken.englishDescription: Looking weak or burned out because one has hollow eyes.

sunken.definitionKo: 속이 비어서 안으로 오목하게 들어가 있다.
sunken.englishDescription: An object being empty, bending inward.
Becoming lean because one is sick and exhausted.

sunken.definitionKo: 눈이 쑥 들어가 있고 생기가 없다.

sunstroke.definitionKo: 강한 햇빛을 오래 받아 일어나는, 머리가 아프고 숨이 가쁘며 심하면 정신을 잃는 병.
sunstroke.englishDescription: A symptom caused by long exposure to strong sunrays, leading one to experience a headache and breathlessness, or collapse in a coma if it becomes worse.

superficial.englishDescription: The level or degree of something being low.
One's thought, knowledge, etc., being not profound.

superficial.definitionKo: 말이나 행동이 조심성 없이 가벼워 존경하거나 믿을 만한 점이 없다.
superficial.englishDescription: Not deserving respect or trust as one speaks or acts lightly and carelessly.

superficial.definitionKo: 겉으로 나타난 일반적인 사실만을 얘기하거나 표현하는.
superficial.englishDescription: Discussing or expressing general facts only, which can be seen from the outside.

superficial.definitionKo: 겉으로 드러나 보이는 현상에만 관련을 맺거나 관심을 가지는.
superficial.englishDescription: Being related to or paying attention to only a visible phenomenon.

surround.englishDescription: To block or hide something by encircling it.
To have something as an issue.

surround.definitionKo: 어떤 물체나 사람의 주위를 둘러서 가리거나 막다.
surround.englishDescription: To hide or block an object or person by surrounding it/him/her.
To form a circle around something.
To put someone or something in the center of one's attention and encircle it.

surround.definitionKo: 물줄기가 어떤 곳의 주위를 빙 둘러 흐르다.
surround.englishDescription: For streams of water to flow around a certain place.

surround.englishExpression: surround; hang; be in the air
surround.englishDescription: For a certain atmosphere or silence, etc., to surround a place.

surround.definitionKo: 분위기나 침묵 등이 주위에 감돌게 되다.
surround.englishExpression: surround; hang; be in the air
surround.englishDescription: For a certain atmosphere or silence, etc., to come to surround a place.

switch.definitionKo: 전기 회로를 이었다 끊었다 하는 장치.
switch.englishDescription: A device that connects and disconnects an electric circuit.

switch.definitionKo: 순서나 위치를 반대로 바꾸거나 마구 섞이게 하다.
switch.englishDescription: To change the order or position to the contrary, or mix the orders or positions at random.

switch.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물을 때릴 때에 쓰는 가는 나뭇가지.
switch.englishDescription: A thin branch or stick used for whipping a person or animal.

takeover.definitionKo: 일이나 물건, 사람 등을 넘겨주거나 넘겨받음.
takeover.englishDescription: An act of passing or taking over a certain task, object, people, etc.

takeover.definitionKo: 일이나 권리, 물건 등을 넘겨받고 물려줌.
takeover.englishDescription: The act of taking over and handing over a certain task, right, object, etc.

thornbush.definitionKo: 어수선하게 엉클어진 가시로 이루어진 나무나 풀.
thornbush.englishDescription: A tree or bushes entwined with thorns.

though.definitionKo: 앞의 내용과 반대되는 내용을 이야기할 때 쓰는 말.
though.englishDescription: A word used to say something opposed to the proposition immediately preceding the word.

timber.definitionKo: 불을 때기 위해 베어 놓은 나무의 줄기나 가지.
timber.englishDescription: The trunk or branches of a tree cut to be used as firewood.

tolerable.englishDescription: Not seriously transgressing the bounds of a certain standard.

tolerable.definitionKo: 정도나 형편이 기준에 크게 벗어나지 않는 상태이다.
tolerable.englishDescription: A degree or situation being not totally against a standard.

tolerable.definitionKo: 상태나 성질이 짐작하거나 다스릴 수 있을 정도로 웬만하다.
tolerable.englishDescription: A state or attribute being easy enough to be estimated or controlled.

tolerable.definitionKo: 상태나 성질이 짐작하거나 다스릴 수 있을 정도로 웬만하다.
tolerable.englishDescription: The state, quality, etc., of something being easy to guess or control.

torso.englishDescription: The upper part of one's body including the waist.

torso.definitionKo: 팔, 다리 등을 제외한 생물의 몸 부분.
torso.englishDescription: A body part of an organism excluding the arms, legs, etc.

tributary.definitionKo: 강의 큰 줄기로 흘러 들어가거나 큰 줄기에서 나온 작은 물줄기.
tributary.englishDescription: A stream that flows into or from a main stem river.

ttakjichigi.definitionKo: 딱지 한 장을 땅바닥에 놓고, 다른 딱지로 쳐서 뒤집히면 그것을 가지는 놀이.
ttakjichigi.englishDescription: playing ttakji: A traditional Korean game in which a player lays a folded paper disk called ttakji on the ground and another player tries to win it by striking it with his/her own ttakji and making it turn over.

ttwari.definitionKo: 짚이나 천으로 만들어 짐을 머리 위에 일 때 머리에 받치는 고리 모양의 물건.
ttwari.englishDescription: A ring-shaped item made of straw or cloth that is placed on the head to carry things on it.

unclog.englishDescription: To break through something that is blocked.

vaccination.definitionKo: 전염병을 미리 막기 위해 백신을 넣은 주사를 맞아 면역성이 생기게 하는 일.
vaccination.englishDescription: The act of developing immunity to a particular disease by getting an injection of a vaccine in order to protect against it.

vaccination.definitionKo: 전염병을 미리 막기 위해 백신을 넣은 주사를 맞는 일. 또는 그런 주사.
vaccination.englishDescription: The act of getting an injection of a vaccine in order to protect against a particular disease, or such an injection.

vaccination.definitionKo: 병의 예방, 치료, 진단, 실험 등을 위해 병원균이나 항독소, 항체 등을 사람이나 동물의 몸속에 넣음. 또는 그렇게 하는 일.
vaccination.englishDescription: The act of injecting germs, antitoxins, antibodies, etc., into the body of a human or animal for disease prevention, treatment, diagnosis, experiment, etc., or such a task.

vancant.englishDescription: Being wide and vacant, evoking a feeling of emptiness.

varnish.definitionKo: 페인트, 옻칠 등과 같이 물건의 겉에 칠해서 그것을 썩지 않게 하거나 외관상 아름답게 하는 재료.
varnish.englishDescription: A material, such as paint or lacquer, that is applied to the surface of an object to prevent it from rotting or to make it look beautiful.

verification.englishDescription: Inspecting and proving that something is true.
An act of finding out if something is true or admitting that it is true.

verification.definitionKo: 어떤 사건이나 내용이나 판단이 진실인지 아닌지를 증거를 들어서 밝힘.
verification.englishDescription: The act of establishing that an event, some certain content, or a decision is true by presenting proof.

vocal.definitionKo: 노래를 부르는 일. 또는 노래를 부르는 사람.
vocal.englishDescription: Singing a song. Or someone who sings.

vocation.englishDescription: An occupation for which a person is suited.

voluptuous.englishDescription: Stimulating someone sexually or evoking desire.
For flesh to be abundant in one’s body.

voucher.definitionKo: 교육, 주택, 의료 등의 복지 서비스를 이용할 때 표시된 금액만큼 돈처럼 사용할 수 있는 표.
voucher.englishDescription: A ticket that can be used like money for the indicated amount when using welfare services such as education, housing, medical care, and so on.

voucher.definitionKo: 한 장씩 떼어 돈처럼 사용하는 표.
voucher.englishDescription: A ticket torn off from the rest and used like money.

weakly.englishDescription: In the state of lacking the energy or desire to do something.

wheel.englishDescription: An object made round in order to spin or roll.
An act of spinning around a place.

wheeze.definitionKo: 목구멍에 가래 등이 걸리거나 코가 막혀 숨을 잘 못 쉬어 소리가 나다.
wheeze.englishDescription: For one's throat or nose to make sound when phlegm is in one's throat or one cannot breathe well when one's nose is blocked.

wheeze.definitionKo: 숨 쉬는 소리가 조금 거칠게 자꾸 나다. 또는 그런 소리를 자꾸 내다.
wheeze.englishDescription: For the sound of breathing roughly to be heard repeatedly; to make such a sound repeatedly.

wheeze.definitionKo: 숨 쉬는 소리가 조금 거칠게 자꾸 나다. 또는 그런 소리를 자꾸 내다.
wheeze.englishDescription: For the sound of breathing roughly to be heard repeatedly; to make such a sound repeatedly.

wheeze.definitionKo: 숨 쉬는 소리를 조금 빠르고 거칠게 자꾸 내다.
wheeze.englishDescription: To keep making the sound of breathing a little fast and roughly.

wheeze.definitionKo: 고르지 않고 거칠고 가쁘게 숨 쉬는 소리가 자꾸 나다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
wheeze.englishDescription: For the sound of breathing irregularly, roughly, and hard, to be heard; to make such a sound.

wheeze.definitionKo: 숨 쉬는 소리가 조금 거칠게 자꾸 나다. 또는 그런 소리를 자꾸 내다.
wheeze.englishDescription: For the sound of breathing roughly to be heard repeatedly, or make such a sound repeatedly.

wheeze.definitionKo: 숨 쉬는 소리를 조금 빠르고 거칠게 내다.
wheeze.englishDescription: To make the sound of breathing a little fast and roughly.

wheeze.definitionKo: 숨 쉬는 소리를 조금 빠르고 거칠게 자꾸 내다.
wheeze.englishDescription: To keep making the sound of breathing a little fast and roughly.

wheeze.definitionKo: 고르지 않고 거칠고 가쁘게 숨 쉬는 소리가 자꾸 나다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
wheeze.englishDescription: For the sound of breathing irregularly, roughly, and hard, to be heard; to make such a sound.

wheeze.definitionKo: 고르지 않고 거칠고 가쁘게 자꾸 숨 쉬는 소리가 나다. 또는 그런 소리를 내다.
wheeze.englishDescription: For the sound of breathing irregularly, roughly, and hard, to be heard; to make such a sound.

wield.definitionKo: 소문이 날 만큼 명성을 내거나 세력을 부리다.
wield.englishDescription: To gain fame or exercise one's influence so much as to be known to everyone.

wield.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 세게 뻗어 휘휘 돌리며 흔들어 대다.
wield.englishDescription: To powerfully stretch something out and wield it by swinging it around.
To arrogantly use one's force in a manner to one's liking.
To swing or shake something randomly and recklessly.

wield.definitionKo: 바람직하지 못한 행동이나 성질을 계속 드러내거나 보이다.
wield.englishDescription: To often show or reveal an undesirable act or personality.
To wield one's power as one likes.

wield.definitionKo: 연장을 휘둘러 나뭇가지 등을 마구 베어 떨어뜨리다.
wield.englishDescription: To wield a tool to cut off branches randomly.
To swing something around wildly from side to side.

wine.englishDescription: Liquor made by fermenting the juice of grapes.

wrap.definitionKo: 얇고 넓은 물건으로 다른 물건을 돌돌 감아 싸다.
wrap.englishDescription: To wrap something by rolling it with a thin, wide object.
To surround something to cover it.

wrap.definitionKo: 팔이나 다리 등을 다른 사람의 몸에 두르다.
wrap.englishDescription: To put one's arms or legs around another person's body.

wrap.definitionKo: 대님이나 붕대와 같이 긴 천으로 된 것을 감거나 두르다.
wrap.englishDescription: To wrap or roll in long cloth such as denim or traditional Korean sock-suspenders, or bandages.
To enfold and cover something completely.

wrap.definitionKo: 모자나 수건 등을 머리에 쓰거나 온몸에 덮다.
wrap.englishDescription: To put on a hat, towel, etc., on one's head, or to cover one's whole body with one.

wrap.definitionKo: 물건이나 사람을 종이나 천 등으로 둘러 씌우다.
wrap.englishDescription: To wrap an object or person with paper, fabric, etc.
To wrap or pack an object.
To put something around a person or thing  to cover him/her or it.

wrapper.englishDescription: What is left on the outside of something after its core or kernel has been removed.

wrapper.definitionKo: 물건을 싸거나 꾸리는 데 쓰는 종이나 비닐.
wrapper.englishDescription: Paper or plastic paper that is used to wrap or pack something.

wristwatch.definitionKo: 손목에 찰 수 있도록 만든 작은 시계.
wristwatch.englishDescription: A small watch made to wear on the wrist.

yoraerajoraera.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '요리하여라 조리하여라' (do in this way and do in that way).
